source.description: Dreams shared by the Dream Library community.

dreams.title: Silk and Ash
dreams.text:
I was on a small patio with 3~4 other girls. Why were we there? To watch a performance maybe? 

I remember alcohol I had taken, from my dream fathers alcohol trunk, and the little chocolate liquor bottles. We were at an event together for some reason, and I remembered that I was the one who gave him that bottle. I remember everything was jewel tone, dark blues and greens, gold accents on the walls. 

Hiding the bottles because of metals not being allowed? I didn't want to get caught with bottles of alcohol with metal decorations. 

The event was apparently some kind of prom, with 2 required outfits. I was ready with a big duffel bag. 

One was green and frilly, and the other was tight and pink. I was missing my pink top, and I was missing my underwear. I improvised by turning something extra into a skirt, to cover up just in case. I found a white top that would work with the pink, but I never got to that outfit before the "instructors" came to inspect. 

They were wearing almost Halloween style outfits? Like monster high dolls. One has a giant ribcage painted on like makeup, like my vr avatar but more extreme. They were very strict about the outfits, and complimented me on my green one, after I finished shoving the bottles at the bottom of my bag. 

There were other people talking about a school they didn't want to go to, but had to. The vampires ( apparently the instructors are vampires) saying they had the perfect school for them, with no trivial rivalries. 

There was one person who looked like milo from childhoods end saying he wanted to learn true history, but felt distracted by his current environment. He was wearing old Victorian era fashion, and had bleached locks. 

Then... Fwoosh. New Story time. 

A story of a mother who went homeless, tried selling her clothes and fashion outside of her van, I see her trade a hat for a single fry, and give it to her son. It's in first person, I'm watching her from her perspective. 

Then, I see the tan van drive away. There's a word painted in black on the back, right above the bumper. It says "peace", and the van disappears. I am now the son. There's a moment of fast forward, someone has been taking care of the boy, and he's older now driving his own car. He sees an old tan van, "peace" written on the back. Driving down a road. Gunshots are being fired from it. 

In 3rd person I see the son drive next to the van, and duck as a dozen bullets pierce the drivers side window and windshield. He brakes before hitting a home, where he watches a man pull an elderly woman up, bleeding from bullet wounds. He tries to go help, but finds TNT on the ground, lit and slowly ticking down. 

He looks back to see his mother with a man, fighting over a trunk. She noticed her son, and is trying to stop the explosion. The man doesn't care and tries preventing her from ruining their plan. He throws a molotov, and somehow the trunk is caught in the explosion. Money is flying everywhere, on fire, burning to ash. I don't know what happened to the son.
dreams.author: The Stranger

dreams.title: Submerged Souls
dreams.text:
I had a dream where I was removing baby animals from the water, bruising them and strangling for slaughter, and then throwing them back in the water. In the water were pigs 3 baby, and 2 foals. Eventually, 2 human babies emerged as well. But these babies were different... With the baby animals, we needed to bring them up to breathe. But they splashed so much, sometimes we would have to realllly pull them up and out. When we got to the babies, I pulled one out and to my surprise, this baby had some sort of super interdimentional power. It could summon water that would go to exactly the shape it wanted but would never interact with our world.

For example, this child comes out crying and clutching the air, and theres a thin sheet of water that is going all the way up where it's grabbing. As if it didnt want to leave the water.
dreams.author: The Stranger

dreams.title: Graduation into Chaos
dreams.text:
I once had a dream where my friends and I were walking outside for a celebration, we had all just graduated from college and spirits were high. It was a fun and beautiful ceremony. After some time, it got really windy. Like hurricane windy. And we all had to run into cars to keep safe. I remember the car we were in not having the brakes on, and we rolled into another car, I ran over someone, and then the spot this car was heading into to crash had just caught fire. So I grabbed everyone in the car and pulled them out before the car was going to explode. 

I think I had everyone bring ourselves to a nearby hospital but suddenly everyone turned into absolute vegetables. Like their brains just stopped. They all started acting crazy like cavemen. And I went to go find the nurse but when I did, she said she was the one who did it. She wanted to make everyone "special needs" because it would be so nice to take care of them all. They'd no longer need to rely on themselves to take care. They'd be "safe". And apparently she drugged me too but my body was immune to the dose like my body is immune to normal anesthesia doses in real life. So I basically had to run and say you can't get me. 

I ran back inside and everyone I knew was jumping all over the place, running everywhere, hurting themselves with the hospital equipment. Chainsaws were being used to cut into skin, blood is getting everywhere. Someone was jumping ontop of the mri machine and riding it like a bull. He falls and breaks his leg and starts screaming. Nobody else reacts, they just keep playing with everything and hurting themselves. I realized it's a lost cause and I had to leave them behind at this point. No point in trying to save a hoard of zombies. 

I remember just running through corridors, running into more groups of mindless cavemen smashing everything. Blood is literally everywhere, there's pools of it on the floor. I remember feeling an exacto blade In my hands while running, feeling bad because I knew weapons weren't allowed in a hospital but I needed it for self defense. Eventually I go through double doors and there's huge surgery rooms. More blood everywhere. I keep running. I hate blood. I hate surgery. I hate bodies being cut open. But I have to go further. 

I find a lady nurse, with other nurses cleaning up a surgery room. These people seem sane. I try and keep my Xacto hidden. I ask where's the nearest exit. She points BACK into where I came from. I groan and go back dreading running into the evil nurse. I wake up.
dreams.author: The Stranger

dreams.title: My Special Dream
dreams.text: I once dreamt I had a nice house with my lovely wife with many children and a golden retriever.

dreams.title: What Heaven Let Me Borrow
dreams.text:
Everything was hazy, yet strangely bright. Almost as if the entire world had been washed in white. I remember being somewhere near a beach, perhaps an island, with a beautiful resort nearby. The atmosphere was peaceful, almost dreamlike, with everything feeling light and distant, as though I had stepped into a place untouched by the rest of the world.

I was on a date with a handsome man with brown hair. I can't remember much about his appearance now, but I remember how I felt around him. I was incredibly shy. So shy, in fact, that I couldn't even bring myself to stand close to him. I would keep a few feet away, admiring him whenever he wasn't looking, stealing little glances whenever I could. I remember feeling almost bashful about the whole thing, like someone experiencing the excitement of affection for the very first time.


Something that settled deep within me. I felt free. Free to enjoy someone's company, free to be affectionate, free to entertain the possibility of falling in love without having to feel guilty about it.

Perhaps part of that shyness came from how unfamiliar everything felt. I had never been with a man before. Despite being much older than the age when people typically begin experiencing these things, I had never known what it was like to hold someone's hand romantically, or to share a kiss.

Then the dream shifted.

I remember waking up in a bed, only to find that the same man was lying beside me. The room was just as bright and hazy as everything else in the dream. I turned toward him, and we simply stared at one another, smiling. Neither of us seemed to need to say anything. There was something so wonderfully comforting about that little moment. It was as though we had known each other for much longer than I could remember.

His face is mostly a blur to me now. I can hardly recall his features, but I still remember a little of his brown hair. Strange how the details of someone's face can disappear so quickly, while the feeling they left behind remains so vivid.

I remember thinking that I wouldn't mind dying right there and then.

Not out of sadness, nor because I wanted my life to end, but because, in that moment, I couldn't imagine anything more I could possibly ask for. Everything felt so pure, so peaceful, so entirely right. I was happy in a way that I don't think I can adequately put into words.

I drifted back to sleep with him beside me, completely at ease. And when I woke again, he was still there. That small detail made everything feel even more real. There was no sudden disappearance, no immediate realization that I was dreaming. He was simply there, as though waking up beside him was something I had done countless times before.

I didn't want it to end.

But eventually, I woke up for real.

And just like that, I was back.

Back to the reality that the dream had allowed me to forget, even if only for a little while.

I began to cry. Not just a few tears, but uncontrollably. I remember lying there and asking, "Why, God? Why would You do that? Why give me a dream like that only to take it away? After waiting for so long, was it really necessary to let me experience something so beautiful just to remind me that it was only a dream?"

It felt cruel. Almost as though I had been allowed to visit a life I had quietly longed for, only to have the door closed the moment I became comfortable.

I lay there for a while, hoping that if I could just fall asleep again, perhaps I could find my way back. Maybe I could return to that beach, that bright little world, and to the person who had made me feel so at peace. I tried to hold on to the last remnants of it, afraid that even the feeling would eventually slip away.

But, of course, I never returned.

Instead, there was only the usual silence.

And the peculiar sadness of missing someone I had never met, mourning a place I had never been, and longing for a moment that had never actually happened.

For a little while, I knew what it felt to be happy.
dreams.author: Lady Enguard

dreams.title: Ten Minutes of Mercy
dreams.text:
I Encountered a rather imposing man, though we were enemies. He was a castle guard, a towering figure dressed in dark, finely tailored clothing beneath a suit of armor. His face was concealed by a dark, expressionless helmet, giving him an almost intimidating, mysterious presence. There was something incredibly striking about him. He carried himself with the confidence of someone who had never once questioned his own strength.

He told me I wouldn’t be allowed to pass unless I defeated him. I wasn't entirely sure what my purpose was for being there, but he was there, and that was enough.

How glorious he looked. Before the battle began, he decided to give himself a handicap. For ten minutes, he wouldn't attack me. He would simply stand there and allow me to throw as many strikes at him as I wanted. Perhaps he pitied me. Maybe he enjoyed doing this with all his challengers, or perhaps he simply wanted to gauge my strength. Either way, there was no going back. He made it clear that even if I decided to turn around and run, he would still come after me once those ten minutes were up. One of us would die here.

He announced that the time had started, then stood completely still, watching me.

I had heard everything he said. He would kill me after ten minutes, regardless of what I chose to do. I figured he had probably done this many times before and had experienced all sorts of reactions. Begging, fighting, fleeing.

But I wasn't afraid. I had already decided what I wanted to do, even if I didn't know why I was there in the first place. All I knew was that I wanted to feel my hands against his chest.

Before I knew it, my body moved on its own, reaching out to touch him and feel the fabric he wore. His shirt glided smoothly beneath my fingers. It was a dark grey, soft suede lined with silk.

"I was just curious," I said in my tired voice. "What lovely fabric."

He asked me what I planned to do. I told him, "I'm doing what you're allowing me to do for these ten minutes. If I'm going to die, and this is our only encounter, I wonder... when was the last time either of us felt the warmth of an embrace?"

I was so tired. My legs felt heavy. I stepped closer and wrapped my arms around him.

"Let this be my final rest."

The hug felt blissful. He was solid and warm. He was understandably confused and initially tried to pull away. I looked up at him.

"Are you not a man of your word?" I asked softly. "Then please, just support me. I don't want to fall."

He didn't say a word. I couldn't read his expression, and I wasn't sure what was going through his mind. My eyes were already growing heavy, and I could feel myself drifting off.

Then I felt it... an arm wrapping around me. My feet lifted off the ground, and I realized he was holding me.

And everything went still.
dreams.author: Lady Enguard

dreams.title: To War
dreams.text: It begins in some kind of bunker, I believe. There's a faint glow of red everywhere that appears to be the lighting. My whole family is there in uniform. My mother is a general and fynn is at a security desk. I've been asked if I want to be a spy in the war. What war? I have no idea. I know nothing of the enemy. My mother brings me to a room where I must be tested. If I pass, I am shipped off as a spy. What am I being tested on? The quality of my cursive handwriting. XD I'm not sure why, but it is imperative that I have proper cursive knowledge and good handwriting or I'd be caught immediately.  She has me write out the alphabet; upper case, then lower case. I forget how a few of them look. She writes them for me and I do my best to copy; but its sloppy. I did learn to write in cursive but it's not exactly a well practiced for nowadays. I failed the test. No spies life for me xD
dreams.author: Turff

dreams.title: The Death Cult
dreams.text:
This dream really stuck with me. It started when I ran into a house with a door who's lock was left open. It led me to a big empty room that was dark, dusty, full of hay. and there was a girl laying in a straw bed. 

Then, out of nowhere, this massive rat runs inside behind me, and starts sniffing around. The girl in the bed stirrs awake and she calls for the rat. The rat recognized her voice, and went to her. His sniffing led him to a pile of food she kept under her pillow. He ate the pile, and then layed ontop of the girl in a very comfortable position. Like a dog claiming it's nap time. "No! That's not what you're supposed to do! You can't stay here like this" said the girl. She lifted him up as best she could, carrying him by the armpits as if he were an overstuffed teddybear, and the rat squealed wanting to be put back down. 

She released him, and off he went further into the house. "That's a good boy. Go ruin these weird peoples property." This... caught me off guard. That is until I met the people who owned the property. They were a group of native (looking??) people who were all dressed in a beautiful white and light blue regalia. They started telling me about how they don't believe in rituals of death. That anything revolving death is a curse, and we should focus on life. The more they explained things to me, the more they sounded like a death cult, Ironically enough to me. 

They took me further into their home, but the dream shifted and I no longer felt like I was where I once was. I was now in a dark house, there were adults in the distance with semi transparent walls, and the rooms were large and bare. A light teal ambiance with red outlines, almost like a cyber space... but the people were now shadowy figures. There were 2 corpses on the floor. One was the body of a child. 

I felt the urge to communicate with the body. When I walked up to the larger one, it asked me for a favor. I don't remember what it was but he needed me to retrieve something from his grandmother's room. To help, I found a candle and lit a piece of red and gold decorated parchment, with scribes in the center that I didn't understand. It disappeared in a puff of smoke, and I was invisible. I ran out of the room, passed through the clear corridor. It made sense to me that I was essentially a ghost walking in between the walls of this place. I made my rounds, none of the adults sensed me, and I came back. Only to find one of the corpses were missing, the one I just spoke to. 

But then, he whispered to me... "Kill him. He's my brother. But not any more. Smash him. Before it's too late."I found a big rock outside and I crushed the head of this small blob of shadow in the shape of a body. The moment I heard the smash, It screamed "why would you do this to me, why did you hurt me." and a shadowy small boy carrying a yellow bunny stuffed animal appeared above the dead corpse. The voice of the other goes "we need to get you out of here. You don't belong here little brother." 

So I made myself invisible once again, holding the hand of the little boy. We walked through the walls together. "They can sense us. They know you're taking me away."... And that's when I woke up.
dreams.author: The Stranger

dreams.title: The Witches Beneath my House
dreams.text:
I was talking to an old lady, and her words ended up being oddly jumbled. I was lucid from the moment I fell into that dream so I was like ok weird, sure. But then a dark shadow flew in the corner of my eye. I looked, saw nothing. Then it zoomed again. I Saw a flash of light, a glimmer of metal on the shadow. My brain instantly went "knife" and I was put into nightmare mode. So, I closed my eyes and just ran in any direction since there were no walls. I started in a black void. After running and opening my eyes, I was back at my parents house. Still being chased. I decided to jump into my mom's minivan and lock it. The shadow couldn't get inside and I was finally feeling safe. I look at it through the window, and it's a small boy wearing all black. He waves at me with this knife and a smile and tells me to come out of the car. I oddly enough felt like I could trust him, so I did. And he opened a door in the garage that led down a spiral staircase, down to where three witches were.

They basically sat me down at this table with 2 dolls. They told me that these 2 dolls represent 2 paths that I am meant to take but only one shall be the future I make. They instruct me to hold the dolls together, press their heads together. And i watch as the 2 dolls begin to morph, deform, mutate and shift grotesquely. Like a shapeshifting melting pot of faces. I see many different faces and clothes appear and change around the now singular head still connected to its 2 bodies until it climaxes to a pause and silence falls the room. I dont remember exactly what was said but i remember the witches explain to me something about how I dont need to ask them to know my future, and I cannot ask them to make sense of my results. And then the dream ends.
dreams.author: The Stranger

dreams.title: Ham Hero
dreams.text:
It starts with a house. It's a farm. A lovely family lives there. They invite me for dinner. They tell stories and laugh and play. They introduce me to their pet pig. The farmer and father of the family is very proud of the fact that he raised such a large pig himself as he grew up. 
Suddenly a large asteroid comes crashing into the yard of the farm. It's burning and red. The family is cautious. Until they notice the family pig getting to close. The farmer panics and jumps for the pig only for the both of them to fall into the crater. 
Then the weirdest thing happens. 
Like canons, both the farmer and the pig shoot out of the crater. Their butts glowing red. They scream like cartoon characters. 
For some reason they have both become animated characters with super powers. 
One of the kids points out they look like characters from their children's book. 
I wake up. XD
dreams.author: Turff

dreams.title: The Wonderful Spectacles
dreams.text:
I was walking alone on the seashore. The day was singularly clear and sunny. Inland lay the most beautiful landscape ever seen; and far off were ranges of tall hills, the highest peaks of which were white with glittering snows. Along the sands by the sea came towards me a man accoutred as a postman. He gave me a letter. It was from you. It ran thus:--

"I have got hold of the earliest and most precious book extant. It was written before the world began. The text is easy enough to read; but the notes, which are very copious and numerous, are in such minute and obscure characters that I cannot make them out. I want you to get for me the spectacles which Swedenborg used to wear; not the smaller pair--those he gave to Hans Christian Andersen--but the large pair, and these seem to have got mislaid. I think they are Spinoza's make. You know he was an optical-glass maker by profession, and the best we have ever had. See if you can get them for me."

When I looked up after reading this letter, I saw the postman hastening away across the sands, and I cried out to him, "Stop! how am I to send the answer? Will you not wait for it?"

He looked round, stopped, and came back to me.

"I have the answer here," he said, tapping his letter-bag, "and I shall deliver it immediately."

------------- * From another letter to the friend mentioned in the note appended to the "Doomed Train."--(Author's Note.) -------------

"How can you have the answer before I have written it?" I asked. "You are making a mistake."

"No," he said." In the city from which I come, the replies are all written at the office, and sent out with the letters themselves. Your reply is in my bag."

"Let me see it," I said. He took another letter from his wallet and gave it to me. I opened it, and read, in my own handwriting, this answer, addressed to you:--

"The spectacles you want can be bought in London. But you will not be able to use them at once, for they have not been worn for many years, and they sadly want cleaning. This you will not be able to do yourself in London, because it is too dark there to see well, and because your fingers are not small enough to clean them properly. Bring them here to me, and I will do it for you."

I gave this letter back to the postman. He smiled and nodded at me; and I then perceived to my astonishment that he wore a camel's-hair tunic round his waist. I had been on the point of addressing him-- I know not why--as Hermes. But I now saw that he must be John the Baptist; and in my fright at having spoken with so great a saint, I awoke!

--London, Jan. 31, 1877

------------------------ * The dreamer knew nothing of Spinoza at this time, and was quite unaware that he was an optician. Subsequent experience made it clear that the spectacles in question were intended to represent her own remarkable faculty of intuitional and interpretative perception. (Ed.) -------------------
dreams.author: Anna Kingsford
